config.page.farming.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Farming-category quests (crop deliveries, Pierre's stock-up, Massive Harvest).
config.page.fishing.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Fishing-category quests (hauls, Rainy Day Catch).
config.page.mining.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Mining-category quests (Skull Cavern dive, bar deliveries).
config.page.foraging.tooltip: Master toggle for Foraging-category quests (seasonal forage, plant trees, debris).
config.page.cooking.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Cooking-category quests (saloon weeklies, grand feasts).
config.page.social.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Social-category quests (check-ins, gift deliveries, poem inspiration).
config.page.seasonal.tooltip: Master toggle for Seasonal-category quests (beach cleanup, spring cleaning, heat wave relief).
config.page.animal.tooltip: Master toggle for Animal-category quests (Marnie's offers, Alex's protein shakes).
config.page.festival.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Festival quests (decor supply, Gus's feasts, Trout Derby, SquidFest, Winter Star).
config.page.adventureBoard.tooltip: Toggle and placement for the Adventurer's Guild board near the Mine entrance.
config.consequences.tooltip: When on, certain quests can affect NPC friendships positively or negatively.
config.moddedItems.tooltip: Lets quest objectives and rewards reference items added by other mods.
config.moddedNPCs.tooltip: Lets modded NPCs (Ridgeside, East Scarp, Visit Mount Vapius, SVE) appear as quest givers.
config.festivalQuests.tooltip: Adds pre-festival quest chains in the days leading up to each festival.
config.animalQuests.tooltip: Enables Marnie's animal quest chain after building coops or barns.
config.farmingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Farming-category quest (crop deliveries, Pierre's stock-up, etc).
config.fishingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Fishing-category quest (fish hauls, overpopulation alerts, derbies).
config.miningQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Mining-category quest (bar deliveries, deep dives, monster hunts).
config.foragingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Foraging-category quest (seasonal forage, plant trees, debris).
config.cookingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Cooking-category quest (saloon weeklies, grand feasts, dinner parties).
config.socialQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Social-category quest (gift deliveries, check-ins, poem inspiration).
config.seasonalQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Seasonal-category quest (beach cleanup, spring cleaning, heat wave relief).
config.secretGiftHint.tooltip: Adds a quest that hints at your Winter Star recipient's preferences. Disable if you'd rather not be spoiled.
config.enableAdventurersGuildBoard.toolt: When on (default), a separate quest board appears near the mine entrance and hosts the mining and monster quests (deep dives, slime clearing, monster eradication). When off, the guild board is hidden entirely and those quests appear on the regular help-wanted board so the content stays reachable. Per-quest weights still let you disable individual quests on top of this.
config.AdventureBoardTileX.tooltip: Tile X coordinate where the player walks to interact with the board (the click target). Default 12 for the Mine entrance.
config.AdventureBoardTileY.tooltip: Tile Y coordinate of the click target. Default 6.
config.AdventureBoardDrawOffsetX.tooltip: Pixel offset applied to the in-world board sprite. 1 tile = 64 pixels. Negative values move left. Lets you park the art on a wall while keeping the click target at a walkable tile.
config.AdventureBoardDrawOffsetY.tooltip: Pixel offset applied to the in-world board sprite. Negative values move up.
config.ShopDiscountPercent.tooltip: Discount applied to a shop after a fishing festival quest.
config.ShopDiscountDurationDays.tooltip: How many days the festival fishing shop discount stays active.
config.SeedShopDiscountPercent.tooltip: Discount on quested seeds at Pierre's after Pierre's Stock-Up.
config.SeedShopDiscountDurationDays.tool: How many days the seed shop discount stays active.
config.QuestCooldownShortDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'short' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling. Used by recurring board / weather / special-order quests that opt into the bucket. One-shot, building, and mail-periodic quests keep their own cooldowns.
config.QuestCooldownMediumDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'medium' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling.
config.QuestCooldownLongDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'long' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling.
config.RainyDayCatchMailChancePercent.to: Probability (0 to 100) that the Rainy Day Catch quest mail arrives on a day where tomorrow is forecast as rain. 100 = always when rain is forecast, 0 disables the quest.
config.FishHaulMediumQty.tooltip: Catch count for medium-tier fishing hauls.
config.FishHaulLargeQty.tooltip: Catch count for expert-tier fishing hauls.
config.CropMassiveQty.tooltip: Crop count for Massive Harvest order.
config.RequestVariationCount.tooltip: How many distinct item variations NPCs ask for in mixed-bag delivery quests like Pierre's Stock-Up. Range 2 to 5. Default 3.
config.SkullCavernMaxLevel.tooltip: Maximum floor target for Skull Cavern Deep Dive quests.
config.WeeklySpecialComplexMinIngredient: Recipes with at least this many distinct ingredient lines qualify for the Complex saloon weekly special and Grand Feast pools.
config.CheckOnFriendsCount.tooltip: How many distinct villagers the Check on Friends quest asks you to talk to before reporting back to the giver.
config.GusFestivalFeastIngredientCount.t: Number of distinct ingredient kinds Gus's Fall and Summer festival feasts ask for.
config.FestivalBiasLuauMagnitude.tooltip: How many tiers higher the governor's Luau reaction lands when you've completed Gus's Summer prep quest. Capped at 5 (loved it); the Mayor's Shorts disqualification is never overwritten.
config.FestivalBiasFairMagnitude.tooltip: Flat bonus added to your Fair grange score before judging when you've completed the Fair decor supply quest. Podium thresholds are 60, 75, and 90, so 15 lifts most submissions one place up. Only applied when 'Fair reward kind' is set to GrangeScoreBonus.
config.FairFestivalRewardKind.tooltip: Picks how the Fair decor supply quest pays you back. GrangeScoreBonus quietly adds to your grange display score before judging. StarTokens skips the bias and instead drops extra star tokens straight into your Fair pouch so you can spend them at the festival shop.
config.FairStarTokensAmount.tooltip: How many extra star tokens land in your Fair pouch when 'Fair reward kind' is set to StarTokens. Default 100 is roughly one mid-priced shop item. Ignored when the grange bonus mode is selected.
quest.farming.basic.title: {{npc}}'s crop request
quest.farming.basic.description: Any kind farmer has some fresh {{item}}? Please bring by {{qty}} {{item}} to {{npc}} before the deadline.
quest.fishing.simple.title: Fresh catch needed
quest.fishing.simple.description: {{npc}} here. I saw some {{item}} splashing around the other day when I was going through {{location}}, but I couldn't catch any. Could someone bring me {{qty}}? I'd really appreciate it.
quest.mining.slime.title: Slime trouble
quest.mining.slime.description: {{npc}} here. The slimes in the mines are getting out of hand. Could a brave adventurer thin them out and report back?
quest.mining.slime.targetMessage: That'll keep the mine quiet for a while. Thanks.
quest.mining.bar.title: {{npc}} needs bars
quest.mining.bar.description: {{npc}} here. I've got an order on the bench and I'm short on stock. Could someone bring me {{qty}} {{item}} before the deadline? I'll make it worth your while.
quest.mining.bar.targetMessage: These are perfect, thanks for getting them so fast.
quest.foraging.seasonal.title: {{npc}}'s foraging request
quest.foraging.seasonal.description: I've been looking for some {{item}} but to no luck. I really want to make some salad with them. If someone finds {{qty}} {{item}}, please bring them by. Thanks! - {{npc}}
quest.foraging.seasonal.targetMessage: Wonderful, thank you for finding these!
quest.social.elliott.title: A token of inspiration
quest.social.elliott.description: Elliott would love a {{item}} for poetic inspiration.
quest.social.elliott.targetMessage: Beautiful. This will be my muse.
quest.social.george.title: Check on George
quest.social.george.description: George has been keeping to himself more than usual lately. He would love a small thoughtful gift and some farm stories. Bring him something he likes, stop by to chat, then let me know how he's doing. - Evelyn
quest.social.george.step.gift: Bring George something he likes or loves.
quest.social.george.step.reportEvelyn: Let Evelyn know how George is doing.
quest.social.george.targetMessage: Thank you for looking in on him. He keeps saying he's fine but I know he misses his friends.
quest.animal.hay.title: Hay supply run
quest.animal.hay.description: My hay supply is running low. Could a kind farmer bring me some more? {{qty}} should be more than enough.
quest.animal.hay.targetMessage: Thanks! The cows were getting antsy.
quest.seasonal.beach.title: {{npc}}'s beach cleanup
quest.seasonal.beach.description: I almost hurt myself on a {{item}} the other day. Can someone pick them up from the beach? You can keep them, just let me know once you've gathered enough.
quest.seasonal.beach.targetMessage: Thanks for clearing those out. Fun to look at but not so fun to step on!
quest.seasonal.floraltea.title: Floral tea for {{npc}}
quest.seasonal.floraltea.description: I'd love to brew some floral tea this week. Could you bring me {{qty}} {{item}}?
quest.cooking.craving.title: {{npc}} is craving a meal
quest.cooking.craving.description: I really really REALLY want some {{item}}. Can someone make some for me?
quest.cooking.craving.targetMessage: Oh, that smells amazing. Thank you! Oh, I made some {{item2}} for dinner, here, have some!
quest.festival.submarineFuel.title: Fuel for the submarine
quest.festival.submarineFuel.description: We need backup power for the submarine during our stay in town. Last time the lights went out at low tide we lost a whole tank of squid and, it's a long story. Ship me {{batteries}} Battery Packs and {{coal}} Coal before the night market starts. The kit takes both.
mail.festival.submarineFuelReward.body: Dear farmer,^^She's running like new. The pearl divers found this little beauty last spring and I've been holding onto it for the right occasion. You should have it. Drop by my submarine while the Night Market is open and I can take you under the sea where you can fish some really peculiar fish.^^  -Captain
quest.festival.wizardsRitual.title: Ritual materials
quest.festival.wizardsRitual.description: The veil thins as Spirit's Eve approaches. The wards I lay each year demand fresh materials, and what I have on hand will not suffice. Place {{count}} Void Essence, {{count}} Bat Wings, and {{count}} Solar Essence in your shipping bin. They will find their way to my study by paths that need not concern you. Whether the working holds well or poorly depends on what you bring.
mail.festival.wizardsRitualReward.body: Dear farmer,^^The working held. The valley sleeps a little easier tonight - though few will know to thank you for it. As payment, an old volume from my study. I have read it more times than I care to admit, and you may yet find a use for it that escaped me.^^  -M. Rasmodius
quest.festival.holidayCookies.title: Holiday cookies
quest.festival.holidayCookies.descriptio: I'm baking holiday cookies for the festival and my pantry is bare. Could you spare {{count}} Flour, {{count}} Sugar, and {{count}} Egg? Any kind of egg will do. Bring them by when you can, there will be a warm batch waiting.
quest.festival.holidayCookies.targetMess: Wonderful! Here, take some of the first batch as a thank you - still warm from the oven.
quest.social.checkOnFriends.title: Check in on a few friends
quest.social.checkOnFriends.description: I haven't had time to make the rounds lately and I worry about how everyone's holding up. Could you stop in on {{names}} and let me know how they're doing? - {{npc}}
quest.social.checkOnFriends.targetMessag: Thank you for taking the time. It really does mean a lot when someone bothers to ask.
quest.festival.gusSpring.title: Gus's festival taste-test
quest.festival.gusSpring.description: Spring is finally back in the saloon kitchen and I'm planning the spread for the Egg Festival. Could you bring me {{cropCount}} {{crop}} and {{forageCount}} {{forage}} when you have the chance? I'll fix you up a sample plate as thanks.
quest.festival.gusSpring.targetMessage: Perfect, just what I needed. Here, try the {{dish}} - tell me honestly what you think.
quest.festival.gusWinter.title: Winter Star feast prep
quest.festival.gusWinter.description: The Winter Star spread won't cook itself and the pantry's looking thin. Ship {{count}} of each: {{item1}}, {{item2}}, {{item3}}. The whole town will appreciate the effort once they hear who pulled it together.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.title: Help break in the preserves jar
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.descri: Heard you finally got a Preserves Jar going. I've been wanting to stock the pantry but I never got around to making my own. Could you ship me {{qty}} pickles or jams (any kind, ship them through the bin and I'll grab them on my end)? No rush, the pantry has all year.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.object: Ship pickles or jams to the shipping bin.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.target: Got the haul. Pantry's finally stocked, thank you.
quest.farming.kegRequest.title: Kegs are running, care to share?
quest.farming.kegRequest.description: I heard you got a Keg working at the farm. I'd love to taste-test whatever's coming out of it. Could you ship me {{qty}} wines, juices, mead, beer, or pale ale (any combination)? Drop them in the shipping bin when you're ready, no deadline.
quest.farming.kegRequest.objective: Ship fermented drinks to the shipping bin.
quest.farming.kegRequest.targetMessage: Cheers, this'll keep me happy for weeks.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.title: Got a Dehydrator going?
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.descript: I noticed you picked up the Dehydrator recipe. Mind making me a batch? Ship {{qty}} dried mushrooms or dried fruit (raisins, etc.) through the bin whenever you can. No rush.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.objectiv: Ship dried mushrooms or dried fruit to the shipping bin.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.targetMe: These will last forever. Thanks for the batch.
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.title: Smoked fish for the pantry
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.descript: Willy told me you have a Fish Smoker running now. I haven't had smoked fish in ages, would you mind shipping me {{qty}} (any kind of smoked fish)? Whenever you have time, no rush.
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.objectiv: Ship smoked fish to the shipping bin.
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.targetMe: Perfect. I'll be eating well for weeks.
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.title: Skull Cavern deep dive
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.descrip: The ores found beyond the deeper floors of the Skull Cavern are apparently exceptional. The Guild would like to investigate further. Reach floor {{floor}} and ship {{count}} ore (any type) through your shipping bin. We'll be in touch the morning after the haul lands.
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.step.re: Reach floor {{floor}} of the Skull Cavern.
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.title: Mines deep dive
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.description: The Adventurer's Guild is paying for a deep dive into the mines. Reach floor {{floor}} and ship {{count}} ore or stone through your shipping bin. Reward comes with the morning after the haul lands.
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.step.ship: Ship {{count}} ore or stone through the bin.
mail.mining.deepDiveReward.body: Dear farmer,^^Your haul came through clean. The Guild had everything smelted overnight and ran the numbers. Here's your share of the bars - {{count}} {{bar}}, payment in full. There's plenty more work like this if you're up for it.^^  -Marlon
mail.mining.deepDiveReward.skullCavern.b: Dear farmer,^^Thanks for the ores. While smelting them, we got a few of these weird looking bars - {{count}} {{bar}} to be exact. Maybe you can find some use for them.^^  -Marlon
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.title: Pierre's stock-up
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.description: Pierre's running low on a few seasonal staples for the store. He's asking for {{count}} each of {{items}}. Bring them by the shop when you can - he'll knock the price down on the seeds for those crops in return.
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.targetMessa: Wonderful, that'll keep the shelves stocked. I've marked down the seeds for those crops as a thank-you.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.title: Massive harvest request
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.description: {{npc}} from JojaMart here. Our usual supplier botched the {{item}} order, so we're stuck with empty crates and a manager breathing down our necks. We need {{qty}} {{item}} into the shipping bin by the deadline, anything you can spare. JojaMart will pay above market for the load.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.targetMessa: Order received. JojaMart appreciates your cooperation.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.consequence: I heard JojaMart finally got a decent batch of {{item}} in. Thank you for that - the store-bought stuff was always rubbish.
Why couldn't {{npc}} get better quality crops instead? I never eat {{item}}.
quest.reward.line.shopDiscount: {{npc}} will mark down their shop {{percent}}% for {{days}} day(s)
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.title: {{npc}}'s weekly special
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.descr: {{npc}} is running {{dish}} as the saloon's special this week. Bring the kitchen everything on the prep list - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a stack of gold and a few happy regulars in it for you.
{{npc}} is testing out a new dish at the saloon this week and the prep list is a bit of a grab bag. Bring everything on it - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a stack of gold waiting for you.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.targe: Perfect, that's the lot. Dinner service is saved.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.conse: I had {{npc}}'s {{dish}} this week. Honestly the best thing I've eaten all season.
{{npc}} ran {{dish}} as the special. You couldn't get me to touch that with a ten foot pole.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.complex.desc: {{npc}} is putting up an ambitious special this week - {{dish}} - and the prep list isn't small. Drop everything off at the saloon: {{ingredients}}. Bigger payday, but the kitchen needs it all by the deadline.
{{npc}} is workshopping something ambitious at the saloon this week and the prep list is a real grab bag. Bring everything on it - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a fat stack of gold waiting.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.complex.cons: {{npc}} had {{dish}} on special. Made my week.
The saloon reeked of {{dish}} all week. I'm still trying to forget it.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.targetMessag: Perfect, that's everything I need for the {{dish}}. Dinner service is saved.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.title: {{npc}}'s grand feast
quest.cooking.grandFeast.text: {{npc}} is throwing a big feast at the saloon this week with {{dishes}} on the menu. They're asking around for help with the prep list. Drop the ingredients in the shipping bin like usual and they'll handle the cooking.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.consequence.lov: {{npc}}'s feast was incredible. I had three plates of {{dish}} alone.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.consequence.hat: Oh! You're the one who supplied the ingredients for {{dish}} at {{npc}}'s feast?! I thought I was going to be sick.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.title: {{npc}}'s fish haul
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.description.joj: {{npc}} from JojaMart here. A shipping mishap left the Zuzu branch dry on {{item}} and the manager wants the shelves restocked yesterday. Bring in {{qty}} {{item}} - we pay on the spot.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.description.pie: Pierre's spotted a side hustle at the Zuzu City waterpark and he's willing to share the take if you can land him {{qty}} {{item}}. Bring them by the shop when you have them.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.targetMessage: Perfect, that's the load. Pleasure doing business.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.consequence.hat: I've noticed fish populations declining. Pulling {{item}} out by the cratefull for {{npc}} isn't going to help.
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.title: Seafood night at {{npc}}'s
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.description: {{npc}} is putting on a seafood night and needs a serious haul - {{qty}} {{item}} for the kitchen. The pay is well above market, but a catch this size won't go unnoticed by the folks who watch the water.
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.targetMessage: That's a haul. The whole valley's eating well tonight.
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.consequence.c: I heard about the {{item}} haul for {{npc}}'s seafood night. That's the kind of catch that empties a fishing hole for years.
I checked the spawn counts again this morning. {{item}} numbers are way down. We may be looking at a generational gap.
I had hoped you'd think twice before pulling that many {{item}} for one dinner service. Trust takes longer to grow back than fish do.
quest.mining.monsterParts.title: {{npc}} needs monster parts
quest.mining.monsterParts.description: {{npc}} is putting in an order for {{qty}} {{item}} - research, alchemy, or just a strong stomach, depends who you ask. Bring them by when you have the count and they'll trade you a gem worth the trip.
quest.mining.monsterParts.consequence.ha: So you're {{npc}}'s {{item}} courier now. The creatures down there have names too, you know.
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.title: Forage gifts for the valley
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.descripti: Linus says the best way to share what the woods give us is to give it back to the people. Find {{count}} folks in town and gift each of them a forage they'll actually love or like. He wants you to think about it before you hand anything over - bringing someone a daffodil they don't care for doesn't count.
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.step.gift: Gift loved or liked forage to {{count}} different villagers.
quest.reward.line.festivalBias.luau: {{npc}} says he'll put in a good word with the governor at the Luau
quest.reward.line.festivalBias.fair: {{npc}} says your contribution will give the grange judges something to talk about
quest.reward.line.fairStarTokens: {{npc}} will slip you {{amount}} extra star tokens to spend at the Fair
quest.festival.gusFall.title: Gus's Fair feast prep
quest.festival.gusFall.description: I'm putting up the saloon's spread for the Fair and the prep list isn't small. Bring me {{ingredients}} when you can. I'll fix you a sample plate, and I'll talk Lewis into giving you a few extra tickets for that prize wheel of his.
quest.festival.gusFall.targetMessage: Perfect, that's the lot. Try the {{dish}}, tell me honestly what you think. Tickets are yours too, save them for the prize wheel at the Fair.
quest.festival.gusSummer.title: Gus's Luau potluck prep
quest.festival.gusSummer.description: The Luau soup is more than I can prep alone this year. Bring me {{ingredients}} when you can. Whatever you contribute makes it into the pot, and I'll make sure to put in a good word for you with the governor.
quest.festival.gusSummer.targetMessage: That'll do it. Try the {{dish}}, tell me honestly what you think. Whatever the soup tastes like at the Luau, you're the reason it tastes that way.
quest.social.giftDelivery.title: A small gift for {{recipient}}
quest.social.giftDelivery.description: I overheard {{recipient}} craving some {{item}} the other day. Maybe you could get them one and make their day?
quest.social.giftDelivery.targetMessage: Oh! Thank you. That's so thoughtful.
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.title: {{npc}}'s heat wave relief
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.descriptio: The clinic is full of folks half-fainted from the heat. {{npc}} is asking for {{qty}} {{item}} to keep around for anyone who comes in dehydrated. Drop them off when you can and there's something for the trouble.
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.targetMess: Perfect. That'll keep half the valley upright through the next hot spell.
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.title: Notes for the Moonlight Jellies
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.descriptio: I'm pulling together some field notes ahead of the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies and could use a few specimens from the beach. Could you bring me {{qty}} {{item}} sometime in the next few days? The dance is coming up fast and the data set isn't going to fill itself.
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.targetMess: These are exactly what I needed. Thanks for indulging the field work.
quest.festival.merchantUnpacking.title: Night Market seeds for {{npc}}
quest.festival.merchantUnpacking.descrip: Farmer, the Magic Boat at the Night Market stocks seeds you can't get anywhere else, and I'd love to try planting some next year. I need {{qty}} of each of these {{varietyCount}} kinds: {{items}}. Ship them through the bin once you've picked them up and I'll owe you one.
quest.mining.monsterHunt.title: Monster bounty
quest.mining.monsterHunt.description: {{npc}} here. I've got a stack of complaints from townsfolk about monsters near the trails. {{qty}} kills should clear the worst of it, type doesn't matter. Stop by when you've thinned the numbers and there's a hot meal waiting.
quest.mining.monsterHunt.targetMessage: Good work. Take this with you, you'll need it for the next run.
quest.foraging.rareForage.title: {{npc}}'s rare forage
quest.foraging.rareForage.description: {{npc}} has heard rumours of {{item}} turning up in the area and wants {{qty}} of them. Bring what you can find, no rush. There'll be coin and seed packets in it for the trouble.
quest.foraging.rareForage.targetMessage: These are the real thing. Thank you for chasing them down.
quest.mining.rareMaterial.title: {{npc}}'s rare material request
quest.mining.rareMaterial.description: {{npc}} here. I'm working on a custom commission and the order calls for {{qty}} {{item}}. I'll cover the going rate and throw in a sweetener for the inconvenience.
quest.mining.rareMaterial.targetMessage: These will do nicely. Tell the customer the timeline's back on schedule.
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.title: A whisper for the Winter Star
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.descriptio: I think {{recipient}} is going through a tough time this winter. Maybe a thoughtful gift would cheer them up. I heard they love {{item}}!
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.step: Give {{recipient}} a {{item}} or something they like during the Festival of the Winter Star.
quest.festival.wrappingPaper.title: Wrapping paper for the festival
quest.festival.wrappingPaper.description: Folks have put in orders for wrapping paper ahead of the gift giving festivities. Please ship {{count}} papers and tapes before the deadline. I have a nice book I can give you as thanks.
quest.farming.qualityCrop.title: {{npc}}'s quality crop order
quest.farming.qualityCrop.description: {{npc}} is putting together a particular meal and only the best {{item}} will do. Bring {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}} when you have them. Anything less and it just won't taste right.
quest.farming.qualityCrop.targetMessage: These look perfect. Thank you for taking the extra care.
quest.farming.premiumCrop.title: {{npc}}'s premium order
quest.farming.premiumCrop.description: {{npc}} is willing to pay a premium for {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}}. They've made it clear nothing short of iridium will land the deal. Bring them by when you have the lot.
quest.farming.premiumCrop.targetMessage: Spectacular. This is exactly what I needed.
quest.fishing.qualityFish.title: {{npc}}'s quality fish order
quest.fishing.qualityFish.description: {{npc}} has a buyer lined up and the kitchen wants only the best. Land {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}} and bring them by when you've got the lot. The pay reflects the difficulty.
quest.fishing.qualityFish.targetMessage: Beautiful catch. This is exactly what was wanted.
quest.festival.moonlightJellies.title: Lights for the Moonlight Jellies
quest.festival.moonlightJellies.descript: Lewis is decking the pier out for the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies and could use a hand. Ship {{torches}} torches and {{wood}} wood through the bin and he'll see something nice gets sent your way.
quest.festival.eggFestivalDecor.title: Hay for the Egg Festival
quest.festival.eggFestivalDecor.descript: Farmer, I need your help decorating the town for the upcoming Egg festival. The rest of the townsfolk have helped out a ton, I just need a few haybales to complete the look. Ship me {{count}} when you can.
quest.festival.dyeForEggs.title: Dye for the Egg Festival
quest.festival.dyeForEggs.description: Farmer, the children are itching to paint eggs at the Egg Festival and the dye kit Pierre stocks is, well, beige. I'd like to set out something brighter this year. Ship me {{countPer}} dyed items in each of these {{colorCount}} colors so we can mix proper paints: {{colors}}. Get them in before festival day and I'll send a little something I had Robin help me put together.
item.eggBasket.cream.name: Cream Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.cream.description: A hand-woven basket lined with pale cream cloth. Robin says she's seen better baskets at the Fair, but Lewis insists this one has character.
item.eggBasket.pink.name: Pink Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.pink.description: A soft pink basket trimmed with ribbon. Looks like it could hold a dozen freshly painted eggs without losing a single one.
item.eggBasket.rustic.name: Rustic Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.rustic.description: A sturdy brown basket made from hardwood splints. The kind of thing you'd grab on the way out to gather eggs at dawn.
quest.festival.fairDecor.title: Fair grounds preparation
quest.festival.fairDecor.description: Farmer, could you spare {{flowers}} fall flowers, {{wood}} wood, and {{signs}} signs for the upcoming Fair decorations? I will remember your favor when judging the grange displays...
quest.festival.luauDecor.title: Luau setup
quest.festival.luauDecor.description: Farmer, I've outpaced the Luau decor budget and I need your help. Ship {{fiber}} fiber, {{hardwood}} hardwood, and {{lamps}} lamps and I'll get Pierre to send you something from his Luau shop stock as a thank you.
quest.festival.spiritsEveDecor.title: Spirit's Eve atmosphere
quest.festival.spiritsEveDecor.descripti: Farmer. Spirit's Eve approaches, and the maze this year asks for a deeper touch than the Mayor's usual fare. Send me {{pumpkinSeeds}} pumpkin seeds for the patch I'm coaxing along the edges, {{cloth}} cloth for the shrouds, and {{torches}} torches to mark the path. I have set aside a few Jack o' Lanterns for you in return.
quest.festival.esvSpiritsEve.title: An East Scarp Spirit's Eve
quest.festival.esvSpiritsEve.description: Rosa's hosting an East Scarp Spirit's Eve gathering and the colour palette is firm: deep purple, slime, stone. Ship {{purple}} purple-coloured items, {{slime}} slime, and {{stone}} stone. The neighbourhood will remember.
quest.festival.rsvGathering.title: Ridgeside Gathering setup
quest.festival.rsvGathering.description: {{farmer}}! I need to dress up the town square for the upcoming gathering and ran short of some stuff. Could you ship {{tubs}} Tub o' Flowers, {{wood}} wood, and {{tables}} tables before the gathering? I'll give you due credit and I'm sure everyone would appreciate you more for helping out. P.S. I snagged this instruction manual for the tubs from Pierre the other day.
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.title: Trouble at {{location}}
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.descriptio: {{npc}} here. The population of {{item}} at {{location}} is way past balanced and the rest of the food web is feeling it. Pull {{qty}} from there and we'll be in better shape.
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.targetMess: Thanks. The numbers should settle now.
quest.fishing.rainyDay.title: Catches that hide in the rain
quest.fishing.rainyDay.description: These ones only bite when it's pouring, and the forecast's finally on our side. If you can land {{qty}} {{item}} while the rain's coming down, I'll thank you with a tackle I found the other day.
quest.fishing.rainyDay.targetMessage: Lovely catch. Rain or shine, you've got the touch!
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.title: Thinning the {{bucket}} catches
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.description.sm: The smaller fishes have been growing in alarming numbers and eating away at the algae and growth along the stream bed. Reduce their numbers before they cause any more harm. Bring back {{qty}} catches under {{maxSize}} inches.
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.description.pr: The number of {{bucket}} fish have been growing in alarming numbers lately and the smaller fish are struggling to survive. Reduce their numbers before the ecosystem collapses. Pull {{qty}} catches measuring at least {{minSize}} inches.
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.targetMessage: Good. The numbers should settle now.
quest.fishing.legendary.title: Tale of the {{item}}
quest.fishing.legendary.description: Hear me out, friend. Old fisher's tale says a {{item}} has been spotted again, and not many folks alive have ever held one. If you've got the patience and the gear, see if you can land one and bring it back to me. There's a worthy haul of bait waiting if you do.
quest.fishing.legendary.targetMessage: I knew you had it in you. That's a story worth telling.
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.title: Rainbow Platter for the Trout Derby
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.descriptio: Farmer! The annual trout derby is coming up and I want to put out some specials at the saloon. Bring in {{qty}} Rainbow Trouts while the event is ongoing and I'll cut you in on the recipe for {{dish}} and a discount!
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.objective: Catch {{qty}} Rainbow Trout during the Trout Derby.
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.targetMess: Beautiful catch. The platter's going to look incredible.
quest.festival.squidFest.title: Showcase dish for SquidFest
quest.festival.squidFest.description: With SquidFest coming up, I'm doing a showcase and I would need {{qty}} squid for the feast. I'll teach you the recipe for {{recipe}} and there will be a discount for the dish at my place just for you as thanks.
quest.festival.squidFest.targetMessage: Perfect. SquidFest is going to be a hit.
quest.animal.alexProtein.title: Protein for the home gym
quest.animal.alexProtein.description: Hey, I'm trying to bulk and Marnie can't seem to keep up with my protein needs. Bring me {{qty}} eggs and I'll cut you in on whatever supplement bottle I've got open. Cheers.
quest.animal.alexProtein.targetMessage: Solid. That's the lot. Here, take this with you.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.title: Specimen for the museum
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.description: I heard a rumor a Dinosaur Egg surfaced on your land. Could you bring it by the museum? I'd love a closer look, and I'd return it in better shape than it arrived. There'll be a fair price for the loan.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.objective: Bring a Dinosaur Egg to Gunther.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.targetMessa: Farmer, thanks for letting me examine this incredible specimen. It turned out to be even better quality than I originally thought! Returning it to you with my thanks.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.title: A note from the sewers
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.description: Friend. A void egg has found you. The little ones of the dark do not come to just anyone. Bring it to me at the sewers. I have something for you in return, something worth more than the egg.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.objective: Bring a Void Egg to Krobus.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.targetMessag: Yes. Yes, this one is healthy. Take this book. It will help you understand what walks beneath the valley.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.title: Leah wants to paint your animals
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.descriptio: I've been itching to paint something with a bit more life in it than a still bowl of fruit. Bring one of your animals over to my place sometime soon, would you? I'll sketch them from a chair on the porch, and there's a little something on the easel for you in return.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.step.visit: Walk into Leah's house with at least one animal following you.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.targetMess: Look at that face. Thank you. Take this for the house, it'll keep something living in the corner of every room.
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.title: Show your animals around town
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.descrip: That deluxe barn of yours looks ready for a proper showing. Take a couple of your animals on a walk into Pelican Town when the weather's nice. The neighbors love seeing healthy livestock around the square, and I'd love hearing back about it.
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.step.wa: Walk into Pelican Town with at least two animals following you.
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.targetM: Look at them, parading around like champions. Everyone's been talking about it. I owe you for that.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.title: Marnie's chicken offer
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.descript: Saw the new coop going up. If you bring me {{qty}} Mixed Seeds for the layers, I'll send a chicken home with you to fill it. Drop the seeds by whenever you have them.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.targetMe: Perfect. Head back to the coop and your new layer will be settling in already.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.coopFull: All your coops are full. Marnie sent the chicken back with a refund instead.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.title: Marnie's cow offer
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.description: Heard you got a barn up. Pick up a {{item}} from my shop and bring it by; once I see you're ready to look after one, I'll send a cow home with you for free. The grass on your pasture will do the rest.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.objective: Buy a {{item}} from Marnie's shop and bring it to her.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.targetMessag: Good. Head back to the barn and your new cow will be waiting for you.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.barnFullFall: All your barns are full. Marnie sent the cow back with a refund instead.
quest.animal.marnieEgg.title: First eggs for Marnie
quest.animal.marnieEgg.description: Congratulations on your first eggs! If you can spare {{qty}} of them through the shipping bin, I'd love to send a Mayonnaise Machine recipe your way and pay the going rate. The hens will give you plenty more.
quest.animal.marnieEgg.targetMessage: Lovely. The recipe is on its way.
quest.animal.marnieMilk.title: First milk for Marnie
quest.animal.marnieMilk.description: Your cow's producing! If you can ship me {{qty}} milk through the bin, I'll send back a Cheese Press recipe so you can start turning that milk into something with a longer shelf life. There'll be coin too, of course.
quest.animal.marnieMilk.targetMessage: Wonderful, that's the lot. Cheese press recipe in the post.
quest.animal.robinSilo.title: Robin's silo offer
quest.animal.robinSilo.description: Now that I've got your new building squared away, I was thinking you really ought to have a silo to go with it before that hay starts piling up. The recipe needs {{stoneQty}} stone, {{clayQty}} clay, and {{copperQty}} copper bars. Here's the deal: if you can bring me any one of those, I'll comp the rest of the materials and the labor myself. Just bring me a stack of stone, or a stack of clay, or the copper bars, whichever's easiest for you. Then swing by the shop whenever you're ready and you can put a silo up wherever you like on the farm, on the house.
quest.animal.robinSilo.objective: Bring Robin {{stoneQty}} Stone, {{clayQty}} Clay, or {{copperQty}} Copper Bars.
quest.animal.robinSilo.targetMessage: Perfect. Come by the shop whenever you're ready to pick out a spot. The silo's on the house.
quest.animal.robinSilo.voucher: Robin is offering a free silo build. Visit the carpenter shop.
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.title: Caroline's tea garden
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.descript: I'm putting together a fresh batch of tea and could really use {{qty}} {{item}}. If you've got some on hand (or know someone who does), drop them off and I'll send you home with plenty of tea leaves to brew with.
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.targetMe: Wonderful! These are going straight in the kettle. Take some tea leaves, you've earned them.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.title: Help clear the debris
quest.foraging.clearDebris.description: {{npc}} would appreciate a hand tidying up around the valley. Could you clear out {{count}} of the bigger logs, boulders, or stumps? Anywhere off the farm is fair game, it all helps.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.objective: Clear {{count}} debris anywhere off the farm.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.step: Clear {{count}} debris anywhere off the farm.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.targetMessage: Looks much better already. Thanks for pitching in.
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.title: {{npc}}'s dinner party
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.description: {{npc}} is hosting a small dinner party and wants the night catered. Cook {{count}} of each of these and bring them over: {{dishes}}.
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.targetMessage: These look incredible. {{npc}}'s guests are going to be thrilled. Here's a little something for your trouble.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.title: Plant some trees
quest.foraging.plantTrees.description: {{npc}} wants the canopy thicker around {{location}}. Plant {{count}} new trees there and they'll be in your debt.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.targetMessage: Beautiful work. The forest will thank you for years.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.title: Spring cleaning
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.descriptio: The weeds are getting out of hand and it's an eyesore. If someone could get rid of {{count}} weeds around town, I would be very grateful.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.objective: Clear {{count}} weeds from anywhere but the farm.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.targetMess: Much tidier. Thanks for taking the time!
